pages.lesson:
LESSON: MODES OF PRESERVATION OF THE QUR’AN

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Qur’an
Topic 1.1: Modes of preservation of the Qur’an

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Modes of preservation of the Qur’an. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is it important to preserve the Qur’an?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the modes of preservation of the Qur’an during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently for posterity
2. recite chapters/verses of the Qur’an as a means of preserving it

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: MODES OF PRESERVATION OF THE QUR’AN
This lesson teaches Modes of preservation of the Qur’an for Grade 8 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. describe the modes of preservation of the Qur’an during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently for posterity
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. recite chapters/verses of the Qur’an as a means of preserving it
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Modes of preservation of the Qur’an using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Modes of preservation of the Qur’an above.
2. Explain Modes of preservation of the Qur’an to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Modes of preservation of the Qur’an.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Modes of preservation of the Qur’an with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Modes of preservation of the Qur’an important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to preserve the Qur’an?
2. How is the Qur’an preserved in modern times?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe the modes of preservation of the Qur’an during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently for posterity
2. recite chapters/verses of the Qur’an as a means of preserving it

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
